title: Contract work
description: Maintenance contracts with business customers, their job logs and monthly invoicing.
selectHint: Select a contract to open its job log.

table.name: Contract
table.countFailed: The uninvoiced count could not be loaded

empty.title: No contracts yet
empty.hint: Create a maintenance contract for a business customer, then log every repaired vehicle under it.
empty.filteredHint: Try another search term or switch the active filter.

form.customerHint: Only business customers can hold a contract.
form.customersFailed: Customers could not be loaded — reopen the form to try again.
form.notBusiness: This customer is not registered as a business customer. Change the customer's type to Business on the Customers page, or pick another customer.
form.noBusinessCustomers: There are no business customers yet. Add the company on the Customers page (type: Business) first.
form.name: Contract name
form.endDateHint: Leave empty for an open-ended contract.
form.termsPlaceholder: Rates, response times, what is included…
form.activeHint: Inactive contracts stay in the history but are hidden from the default list.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name for the contract
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date
validation.dateRequired: Enter the date of the job
validation.hoursInvalid: Enter hours as a positive number, e.g. 1,5

jobs.title: Job log — {{name}}
jobs.lockedHint: Invoiced jobs are locked — credit the invoice to change them.
jobs.emptyHint: Log every repaired vehicle here. Uninvoiced jobs are billed with “Invoice month”.
jobs.emptyFilteredHint: Switch the filter to see the other jobs.

jobForm.hoursHint: Labour hours, if billed by the hour
jobForm.amountHint: Amount incl. VAT as agreed in the contract

deleteJob.title: Delete job?
deleteJob.message: The job {{vehicleRef}} from {{date}} ({{amount}}) will be removed from the log. This cannot be undone.
deleteJob.alreadyInvoiced: This job is already on an invoice, so it can no longer be changed or deleted. Credit the invoice instead.

invoiceMonth.title: Invoice a month — {{name}}
invoiceMonth.intro: Creates one draft invoice to {{company}} with a line per uninvoiced job of the chosen month. Those jobs are then marked invoiced and locked.
invoiceMonth.nothingUninvoiced: No uninvoiced jobs on this contract.
invoiceMonth.truncated: Showing the 200 most recent uninvoiced jobs; older months may also have jobs.
invoiceMonth.noJobs: There are no uninvoiced jobs for {{month}}. Add jobs for that month or choose another month.
